prompts.initial: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: original mobile RPG running sprite atlas. Image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND OUTFIT reference; image 2 is STYLE, SCALE AND GRID reference only. Make this character in the same polished three-head-tall storybook 3D chibi style as image 2. Preserve the character's face shape, age, hair, glasses if any, and exact original outfit/colors from IMAGE 1; do not turn them into the male character from image 2. Stow any held object safely in belt pouch or satchel so both arms can run freely. Real transparent background alpha, no opaque or semi-transparent backdrop. EXACTLY 8 isolated full body sprites in a regular 4 columns by 2 rows, landscape 1536x1024, each cell 384x512. Columns LEFT TO RIGHT: facing FRONT/south; facing BACK/north (back of head); strict LEFT/west profile; strict RIGHT/east profile. Both rows must keep exactly that same orientation order. Top row running stride A left leg forward/right leg back with opposing arms. Bottom row running stride B right leg forward/left leg back with opposing arms. Noticeably different alternating strides. All eight must fit fully within their cells at the same scale, around 3 heads tall, feet baseline at 90% cell height, consistent cell center. Keep at least 8% clear gutters on every cell edge. No cut-off hair, coat, shoes, arms. Transparent empty margins. No frame boxes, numbers, labels, text, floor, cast shadows, extra people, trademarks or watermarks. Every cell contains exactly one character, never overlap adjacent cells. Prioritize technical game atlas layout and identity consistency.
prompts.poseRepair: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct this game animation atlas. KEEP all TOP ROW sprites and all faces, age, hairstyles, costumes, proportions and cell alignment unchanged. Change ONLY the LOWER ROW four character poses into the PASSING / HIGH-KNEE PHASE OF RUNNING, visibly different from top row's wide-extended stride: torso a little upright, near knee raised high toward waist, far leg planted almost straight vertically under hips, feet much CLOSER horizontally instead of spread apart; opposite arm raised. In all four BOTTOM cells, the pose must be clearly different from the TOP sprite in that same column, or this animation does not work. Column1 front/south, col2 back/north no face, col3 LEFT profile, col4 RIGHT profile. Exact regular 4 columns x2 rows,1536x1024 image; each cell384x512. Maintain same scale, head center and 90% cell-height lowest-foot baseline. Keep all body parts inside their own cells with transparent margins. True alpha transparent background, no background, no colored backdrop, no shadows, no borders, no text. This is a clean production two-keyframe looping run cycle: upper row contact/stride; lower row passing/high knee. Preserve colors, detailed art style and character identity perfectly.
